name: Kosmos-1517
about: Kosmos-1517 (1983-125A), a crewed vehicle (BOR-4), launched 1983 Dec 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1983 Dec 27), held fixed
GCAT names the site (Black Sea) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
